Read the hammer miner scrypt dc06 330 mh s page

Hi, thanks for writing in.

The Hammer Miner DC08 (480 MH/s, about 137W) is live at $539 USD, and it ships with the plug matched to your address. The block you are hitting is in our checkout's shipping settings, not the stock, so it is not something I can unlock from my side.

I have passed it to Georges on our team with your note. He handles orders outside our usual regions and can set up the shipping and payment for the Philippines directly. The team is offline right now and picks this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and his reply comes straight back to you in this thread, so there is nothing you need to send again.

One thing worth knowing in the meantime: on any unit going to the Philippines, import duties and local VAT are charged on delivery by customs, and we cannot collect or quote those at checkout.

If you would rather he also price the DOGE DUO PACK (the DC06 plus the DC08, 810 MH/s together at $799.99), just say so and I will add it to the note.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
